## Summary

## Scope

## Testing

- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Unit/component tests pass
- [ ] API/integration tests pass where relevant
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Critical user flow tested manually where relevant

## User experience

- [ ] Keyboard/focus behavior checked for interactive changes
- [ ] Responsive behavior checked on mobile and desktop
- [ ] Empty/loading/error states considered
- [ ] Existing design tokens/components reused instead of duplicating styles

## SEO/content

- [ ] Metadata/canonical/indexing behavior checked if public routing changed
- [ ] Claims, prices, reviews and trust statements are source-backed
- [ ] Reusable copy/config was centralized rather than duplicated

## Database/deployment

- [ ] No database change
- [ ] Migration included and backward-compatible
- [ ] Environment-variable changes documented
- [ ] Rollback/deployment notes added when needed

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visual changes.

## Notes for reviewer

Call out risky assumptions, follow-up work, or areas that deserve extra review.
